scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您现在携带的物品太多了。请先将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Granny]
I wish I could make some clothing for my grandchildren for the festival season...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
我真希望能给孙辈们做几件节日穿的衣服...

scripts.text:
[Granny]
Oh! Would you give me your ^3355FFSkirt of Virgin^000000? I'd need four of them. Please, I'm begging you.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
哦！能把你的^3355FF韩服^000000给我吗？我需要四件。拜托了，求求你了。

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: No way!
scripts.translation: 绝对不行！

scripts.text:
[Granny]
Oh! Thank you so much~ Now I can make some clothes for Kitty Cutty~
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
哦！太感谢你了~ 现在我可以给小猫咪做衣服了~

scripts.text:
[Granny]
Ah, Wait! I almost forgot. I was quite a popular actress back in my youth. My actor friends gave me a wedding present when I left the Troupe. I've kept it to remind me of those precious times.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
啊，等等！我差点忘了。我年轻时曾是个很受欢迎的演员。离开剧团时，我的演员朋友们送了我一份结婚礼物。我一直留着它，以纪念那段珍贵的时光。

scripts.text:
[Granny]
If it's okay...
I'd like to give you this.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
如果不介意的话...
我想把这个送给你。

scripts.text:
[Granny]
Goodbye, adventurer~!
Thank you for making an old woman so happy...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
再见了，冒险者~！
谢谢你让一个老妇人如此开心...

scripts.text:
[Granny]
*Sigh* How can I get ^3355FFSkirt of Virgin^000000 by myself? I'm just so weak and feeble, even rolling in my rocking chair exhausts me. *Sniff* All I want is to make my grandchildren happy...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
*叹气* 我自己怎么才能得到^3355FF韩服^000000呢？我身体太虚弱了，连摇着摇椅都累得够呛。*抽泣* 我只想让孙辈们开心...

scripts.text:
[Granny]
I gather Mushrooms on the Mountain of Payon everyday. Time passes and before I know it, it's already fesitval season. I wish I could make clothing for my family this time of the year.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
我每天都在斐扬山上采蘑菇。时间过得真快，不知不觉又到了节日季。我真希望能在这个时节为家人做几件衣服。

scripts.text:
[Granny]
...
But for that, I need ^3355FF4 Skirt of Virgin^000000...

[Granny]
Young traveler, please help me. When you find some ^3355FFSkirt of Virgin^000000, please bring them to me. I'd really appreciate it...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
年轻的旅行者，请帮帮我。如果你找到^3355FF韩服^000000，请带给我。我会非常感激的...

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
My family has produced and sold the special Winter product ^3355FFEar Muffs^000000 for many years. We just moved here, but the weather is always warm so we can hardly make a living.
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
我家多年来一直生产并销售冬季特供品^3355FF耳罩^000000。我们刚搬到这里，但这里天气总是很暖和，所以生意很难做。

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
If you plan to travel to colder regions, I suggest that you bring some ^3355FFEar Muffs^000000...
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
如果你打算去更冷的地区旅行，我建议带一些^3355FF耳罩^000000...

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
Ear Muffs are my family's specialty, and we provide it to customers who have ^FF33551 Cursed Ruby^000000, ^3311AA1 Headset,^000000 ^3355FF 200 Feathers^000000 and ^DDDD005000 Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
耳罩是我家的特产，我们向拥有^FF33551颗诅咒红宝石^000000、^3311AA1个头戴式耳机^000000、^3355FF200根羽毛^000000和^DDDD005000 Zeny^000000的顾客提供耳罩。

scripts.text: Oh Yeah? That sounds good.
scripts.translation: 哦，是吗？听起来不错。

scripts.text: No thank you, Ma'am.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢女士。

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
Here, I will give you this pre-made one.
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
给你，这是预先做好的。

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
Thank you for buying our product. You won't regret purchasing our Ear Muffs: Satisfaction guaranteed~
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
感谢购买我们的产品。你不会后悔买我们的耳罩的：保证满意~

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
Oh dear...
You don't have enough money or items. Unfortunately, we can't give any discounts. Please understand that we have to make a living...
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
哎呀...
你的钱或物品不够。很遗憾，我们无法提供折扣。请理解我们需要谋生...

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
That's fine.
I believe we
will meet again.
...One of these days.
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
没关系。
我相信我们
还会再见的。
...总有一天。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
ArrrGggghh!
Ah, No I can't...
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
啊...啊...啊...！
啊，不行，我做不到...

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
*Huk*
Now even my eyes have gone mad!! Why do these bugs suddenly seem so cute?! Nooooooo~!!!
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
*噗*
现在连我的眼睛都疯了！！为什么这些虫子突然看起来这么可爱？！不~~~~~！！！

scripts.text: Show Ora Ora
scripts.translation: 展示欧拉欧拉

scripts.text: Give Ora Ora
scripts.translation: 交出欧拉欧拉

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Oooooohhhh!!!
Is, is this
the one?!
This is...
Ora Ora!!
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
噢噢噢噢！！
这、这是
那个吗？！
这就是...
欧拉欧拉！！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
I'll make it short! Give it to me, and I will give you my treasure! So how's my idea? Wanna deal?
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
长话短说！把它给我，我就把我的宝物给你。怎么样？这笔交易划算吗？

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Muhahahahah!!!
I finally have this!
Ora Ora!
Stupid and Disgusting
Thief Bugs!!
You will pay!!!
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
穆哈哈哈哈哈！！
我终于得到它了！
欧拉欧拉！
愚蠢又恶心的
浮勒盗虫！！
你们要付出代价！！！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Huk...Huk...
Sorry, I was out of control with pleasure for a while. Now, I will give my treasure as promised.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
呼...呼...
抱歉，刚才我因为太兴奋而失控了。现在，我会遵守承诺，把宝物给你。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
When you wear this over your mouth and start to breathe, it filters junk out before getting to your lungs.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
把它戴在嘴上开始呼吸时，它会在空气进入肺部之前过滤掉杂质。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Kakakakakaka!
I can't wait
to use this
Ora Ora!
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
卡卡卡卡卡！
我迫不及待
想使用这个
欧拉欧拉了！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Huhuhuhuhu...
What if I can't get rid of all these Thief Bugs? I might even grow to love them... *Huk*
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
呼呼呼呼...
万一我没能除掉所有这些浮勒盗虫怎么办？我甚至可能会爱上它们... *噗*

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Wahhhhhh! I, I...
I can't take it any more!
You little stinky filthy bastards!
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
哇啊啊啊！我、我...
我受不了了！
你们这群又臭又脏的混蛋！

scripts.text: Continue
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Oh man...
It all started when my parents passed away when I was a little kid. Early on I had to work for a living, and had a really hard time.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
天哪...
这一切都从我小时候父母去世开始。我很早就得出来谋生，日子过得非常艰难。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
I've worked for 10 years in hopes of buying my dream house where I could find some sense of peace and comfort again. Eventually I thought I had enough zeny to afford my very own sweet home.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
我工作了10年，希望能买到梦想中的房子，在那里找回一些平静和舒适。最终我以为我攒够了Zeny，可以买一个属于我自己的甜蜜小窝了。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Unfortunately I didn't have enough money to buy the nice house that I had my eye on. But then, I found this house, which was bigger and cheaper than the first. I bought it without thinking...
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
不幸的是，我没有足够的钱买下我看中的那栋漂亮房子。但后来，我发现了这栋房子，它比第一栋更大更便宜。我没怎么想就买下了...

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Sweet Jesus! Turns out, it's a Heaven for Thief Bugs!!!
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
天哪！原来这里是浮勒盗虫的天堂！！！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
I tried to do everything I could do. I coaxed them, killed them, but it only brought peace for a moment! I even tried to burn this house down...!
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
我试遍了所有办法。我哄它们，杀它们，但只能换来片刻的安宁！我甚至试过把这房子烧掉...！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
*Gasp* I mean, really, do I need ^3355FF Ora Ora^000000 to get rid of them? People say it is very rarely seen in distant countries.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
*倒吸凉气* 我是说，真的，我需要^3355FF 欧拉欧拉^000000来除掉它们吗？人们说这在遥远的国家很少见。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
If I could afford 5 of them, I won't have to be frustrated with these disgusting bugs any more...
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
如果我能买得起5个，我就不必再为这些恶心的虫子烦恼了...

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
This never ending fight with the bugs has really exhausted me. I give up. Do as you wish you scumbags!
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
这场与虫子没完没了的战斗真的让我精疲力竭。我放弃了。你们这群人渣，爱怎么样就怎么样吧！

scripts.text:
[Young man]
...What is it?
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
...怎么了？

scripts.text: Can you make me a special item?
scripts.translation: 你能给我制作一个特殊物品吗？

scripts.text: Hey.
scripts.translation: 嘿。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Huh? So you already know what I specialize in, eh? I suppose there's no need for the usual secrecy. Tell me what you want.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
哦？看来你已经知道我的专长是什么了。既然这样，也没必要再守口如瓶了。告诉我，你想要什么。

scripts.text: Helm of Angel.
scripts.translation: 天使头盔

scripts.text: Deviruchi Cap.
scripts.translation: 小恶魔帽

scripts.text: I will come next time.
scripts.translation: 我下次再来。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
1 Helm (with slot).
1 Angel Wing.
5 Fang of Garm.
That's all I require.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
1个头盔（带插槽）。
1个天使发圈。
5个狮鹫兽的指甲。
只需要这些。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Wait! Just so you know, I don't care if the items in your inventory have been upgraded, or have cards attached.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
等等！先说明一下，我不在乎你背包里的物品是否经过强化，或者插了卡片。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
I mean, any cards or upgrades in the items I will use to make something for you will be lost once I make the item. So be careful when you hand stuff over to me.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
我的意思是，用来制作物品的材料上附带的任何卡片或强化等级，在制作完成后都会消失。所以把东西交给我之前，请三思。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Did you gather the items? Then hand them over.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
材料都集齐了吗？那就交给我吧。

scripts.text: Give him the items.
scripts.translation: 把物品交给他。

scripts.text: Don't give him the items.
scripts.translation: 不给他物品

scripts.text:
[Young man]
.....Hm.
Fine, here's your Helm of Angel. Take it.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
……嗯。
好了，这是你的天使头盔。拿去吧。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
...The number of items is not right. You better double check.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
……材料数量不对。你最好再检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Do as you wish...
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
随你便……

scripts.text:
[Young man]
600 Little Evil Horn.
40 Talon of Griffon.
That's all I require.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
600个小恶魔角。
40个狮鹫兽的指甲。
只需要这些。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Wait! Just so you know, I don't care if the items in your inventory have been upgraded, or have cards attached.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
等等！先说明一下，我不在乎你背包里的物品是否经过强化，或者插了卡片。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
I mean, any cards or upgrades in the items I will use to make something for you will be lost once I make the item. So be careful when you hand stuff over to me.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
我的意思是，用来制作物品的材料上附带的任何卡片或强化等级，在制作完成后都会消失。所以把东西交给我之前，请三思。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Did you gather the items? Then hand them over.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
材料都集齐了吗？那就交给我吧。

scripts.text: Give him the items.
scripts.translation: 把物品交给他。

scripts.text: Don't give him the items.
scripts.translation: 不给他物品

scripts.text:
[Young man]
.....Hm. Here's your Deviruchi Hat. Please take it.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
……嗯。这是你的小恶魔帽。请拿好。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
...The number of items isn't right. You better double check.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
……材料数量不对。你最好再检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Do as you wish...
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
随你便……

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Hm. Alright.
Then we shall meet again.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
嗯。好的。
那我们下次再见。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Hm.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[年轻男子]
嗯。
保重。
